claims.text: The driver's own GPS trace places him inside the pickup geofence for a single continuous run of 79 seconds — 9 consecutive qualifying fixes from 06:28:20 to 06:29:39 — which is 101 seconds short of the 180-second free waiting period in force for this STANDARD pickup. The effective in-geofence dwell is shorter than the period the cancellation fee was meant to buy, so under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full.

The trip record agrees with the trace: the driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 06:28:20 and the free waiting period of 180 seconds started at 06:28:22, but he cancelled the trip at 06:29:42 — 82 seconds after arrival. On the platform's own telemetry the waiting period in force under POL-NS-01(c) had not been served when he terminated.

POL-NS-01 is conjunctive and limb (d) fails independently of the dwell point: the trip was terminated at 06:29:42, before the required 180-second dwell — measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 06:28:20 — would have elapsed at 06:31:20. The cancellation therefore did not fall 'at or after the moment the required dwell elapsed', and limb (d) is not met.

Nothing can rescue the shortfall by accumulation. The only advisory in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-02730-01, is MISSING — no advisory covers this pickup in this window — and carries weight 0.0 with the MISSING_ARTIFACT issue code, so it can carry no fact and cannot support summing intervals under POL-NS-06(i); independently, the trace shows a single in-geofence interval (run_count 1), so there is no second interval for that limb to add.

The rider was trying to coordinate and the driver went silent. The rider's message 'coming out now' — a coordinating statement that the rider was on their way out — was sent at 06:29:20 and delivered at 06:29:21; the chat log holds exactly one message, from the rider, the driver posted no reply at all, and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so the driver neither answered within 120 seconds nor called before terminating the trip 22 seconds after the message. Limbs (a) and (b) of POL-NS-04 hold.

Limb (c) of POL-NS-04 is affirmatively satisfied, not undecidable: the rider's device was at the pin throughout, with all 30 qualifying rider fixes inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius and a maximum distance of 23.2 m from the pickup. With all three limbs of POL-NS-04 met, the rider is exonerated and the cancellation fee is refunded in full with no driver compensation payable.

No driver compensation can attach to this trip. POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and limb (c) is not satisfied; POL-NS-04 in any event carries no driver compensation. The driver's 82-second wait is a cost he may raise with the platform, but it is not a charge the rider funds on these facts.

The driver's counterparty statement invites the tribunal to rule on the rider's no-show history, but rider_profile.prior_no_show_flags (6) is a LIFETIME counter that POL-GEN-01 marks CONTEXT ONLY and forbids as a ground of decision, and it is not the trailing-window counter the policy names. The citable field, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d, is 1 — well below the POL-NS-09(d) threshold of 3 — so the history argument neither grounds an adverse finding nor triggers escalation.

The money at stake is the whole 4.50 SGD cancellation fee: the fare_breakdown carries a cancellation_fee line of 4.50 with total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. The contested amount is therefore the full fee, and the rider's claim is supported in full — FULL_REFUND of the cancellation-fee line, with no booking or platform fee to consider on a trip that never started.

POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (b) are therefore satisfied on the driver's own evidence, and there is no false-arrival case for the driver to answer under POL-NS-05.

The trip_record terminates the trip under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is one of the three codes POL-NS-01(d) recognises, with no boarding event and started_at null. The reason-code defect limb (d) polices - a DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE admission that the driver could not find the rider - is not in this record, so the driver terminated honestly rather than mislabelling a rider cancellation as a no-show.

The only chat message on the trip is the rider's 'coming out now' at 2026-09-10T06:29:20. It states no position, names no entrance, block, tower or bay, does not ask for the driver's position and does not say she cannot see the vehicle; it is not the locating or coordinating message POL-NS-04(a) requires, so the rider-exonerating route under POL-NS-04 is not opened on this chat_log, and the driver's cancellation 22 seconds later was not a refusal to answer a request he had been given.

The driver did not circle or leave and return: the trace shows a single continuous in-geofence run with the vehicle at 0.0 km/h at the marker, and the track only departs the pin after the 06:29:42 termination. ruling.explanation: Both sides' accounts of the timing agree, and the arithmetic decides this case. The driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 06:28:20 and the free waiting period of 180 seconds in force for this STANDARD pickup began at 06:28:22 (EV-TRIP-02730, platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180). The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02730) places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for a single continuous run of 79 seconds, from 06:28:20 to 06:29:39, and the trip was terminated at 06:29:42. The effective in-geofence dwell of 79 seconds is 101 seconds short of the required 180 seconds. Under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is therefore not chargeable and is refunded in full: the 4.50 SGD cancellation_fee line on EV-FARE-02730, which is the whole contested amount, with no booking or platform fee to consider on a trip that never started. The same arithmetic fails POL-NS-01 limb (c) (continuous dwell short of the free waiting period) and limb (d) (the termination at 06:29:42 came before the required dwell would have elapsed at 06:31:20), so the fee cannot stand on the baseline clause either. Nothing rescues the shortfall by accumulation: the only advisory, EV-ADVIS-02730-01, is MISSING, carries weight 0.0 and the MISSING_ARTIFACT issue code, and can carry no fact; independently the trace shows a single in-geofence interval (run_count 1), so POL-NS-06(i) has no second interval to add. The driver's arrival marker was not false — he was stationary at the pin at 06:28:20 — so POL-NS-05 and its false-arrival referral do not apply. No driver compensation is payable: POL-NS-07 is conditioned on POL-NS-01 being satisfied in full, which it is not, and the anti-farming check does not trip in any event (driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d = 1 against a threshold of 4, rate 1/65 = 0.015 against 0.08). On the rider's POL-NS-04 claims — the single chat message 'coming out now' at 06:29:20, the driver's silence, and the rider's device sitting within 23.2 m of the pin across all 30 qualifying fixes — the point does not change the outcome, because whether or not limb (a) is met, POL-NS-06 already refunds the fee in full with no compensation. The driver's reference to the rider's no-show history is context only: POL-GEN-01 makes prior_no_show_flags (6) a lifetime counter that cannot ground any finding, and the citable field rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below POL-NS-09(d)'s threshold of 3, so no escalation follows; the driver's statement does not move the case. No artifact is impaired under POL-NS-08(a)–(d): the arrival timestamp matches its nearest GPS fix, the trace has no gaps and full 100% coverage, the chat count matches trip_record.chat_message_count, and the 4.50 SGD fare line reconciles to the net fee produced by the resolution rule, so confidence is not capped. The monetary effect of 4.50 SGD is below the 8.00 SGD execution threshold of POL-GEN-05 and executes automatically.

The SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on TRP-02730 is refunded in full. POL-NS-01 is conjunctive, and its waiting-period limbs fail on the driver's own evidence. The GPS trace EV-GPS-02730 shows the single qualifying in-geofence run at the pin lasting 79 seconds, from 06:28:20 to 06:29:39; the platform's trip record EV-TRIP-02730 agrees, starting the 180-second free waiting period at 06:28:22 and terminating at 06:29:42. The dwell is 101 seconds short of the 180-second free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec). POL-NS-01(c) is therefore not met, and because the 06:29:42 cancellation also precedes the moment that dwell would have elapsed (06:31:20), limb (d) fails independently. Under POL-NS-06 the fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full. POL-NS-07 cannot pay the driver, being conditioned on POL-NS-01 being satisfied in full, and because the stationary fixes lay inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, POL-NS-03 does not apply either. Driver's arguments: the arrival marker was truthful — the trace places him at the pin (closest approach 0.16 m, 9 consecutive qualifying fixes inside the radius) at the 06:28:20 'I'm Here' timestamp — so POL-NS-05 is not engaged and no false-arrival referral arises; the RIDER_NO_SHOW code is one of the three POL-NS-01(d) recognises, so this is not a mislabelled DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE case and no driver-education referral arises; and the anti-farming check is not met (no_show_terminations_30d 1 against a threshold of 4, and 1/65 against a rate above 0.08), so no payout is withheld and no escalation follows. Reaching the pin honestly is acknowledged, but arriving does not shorten the waiting period the fee buys. Rider's arguments: the 79-second dwell, the trip record's 82 seconds, and the independent limb (d) failure are all accepted and all point the same way. On POL-NS-04, the single message 'coming out now' (06:29:20) names no position, entrance/block/tower/bay, asks for the driver's position, and does not say the rider cannot see the vehicle, so I do not rest on limb (a); in any event POL-NS-04 and POL-NS-06 produce the same outcome here (full refund, no driver compensation), so the point is not decisive, though the rider's presence is confirmed (all 30 rider fixes within 100 m, max 23.2 m). On the driver's counterparty statement about the rider's history (EV-RPROF-02730): POL-GEN-01 marks prior_no_show_flags as CONTEXT ONLY and it cannot ground a finding; the only citable counter, no_show_disputes_30d, is 1, below POL-NS-09(d)'s threshold of 3, so the statement changes nothing and triggers no escalation. The deciding facts are carried by EV-GPS-02730 and EV-TRIP-02730, both weight 1.0, so the confidence cap is 1.00. The missing advisory EV-ADVIS-02730-01 (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) carries no fact: there is only one in-geofence interval, so accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) does not arise. The monetary effect of SGD 4.50 is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold and executes automatically.

This is a NO_SHOW_CHARGE dispute over the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee (EV-FARE-02730: cancellation_fee line 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). Both of you read the arithmetic the same way, and so do I.

WHAT THE DRIVER GOT RIGHT. The driver genuinely arrived and did not false-tap. EV-GPS-02730 places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius at 06:28:20, the same instant as the trip_record 'I'm Here' event (EV-TRIP-02730), so POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (b) hold and the POL-NS-05 false-arrival branch is not engaged (his speed at the marker was 0.0 km/h, and he was inside the radius, not merely within 300 m). His termination was recorded under RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes POL-NS-01(d) recognises, so the DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE problem that clause polices is absent and no 'mis-selected reason code' referral arises.

WHY THE FEE NONETHELESS COMES BACK. The charge turns on the dwell, and the dwell is short. The qualifying in-geofence run is 79 seconds (06:28:20 to 06:29:39, 9 fixes); the free waiting period in force is 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec); the shortfall is 101 seconds. The driver cancelled at 06:29:42, well before the required dwell would have elapsed at 06:31:20. So POL-NS-01 limb (c) fails, and limb (d) fails with it, because a termination before the dwell has run is not a termination 'at or after' it. Under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is therefore not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full. Nothing rescues the shortfall by accumulation: the only advisory, EV-ADVIS-02730-01, is MISSING (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) and can carry no fact, and in any event the trace shows a single in-geofence interval (run_count 1), so POL-NS-06(i) has nothing to add. Because the advisory is absent rather than asserted, POL-NS-09 is not triggered by it.

POL-NS-04. The rider's one message, 'coming out now' (06:29:20), went unanswered and the rider's device sat within 23.2 m of the pin (all 30 qualifying rider fixes inside the 100 m radius). Whether that message is a 'locating or coordinating' message within limb (a) is arguable, but it changes nothing: the fee is refunded in full under POL-NS-06 whether or not POL-NS-04 opens, and neither route carries driver compensation.

DRIVER COMPENSATION. POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it; POL-NS-06 displaces it here, so no compensation is payable. The anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d is 1 and completed_trips_30d is 65, far below the 4-and-0.08 test), and no POL-NS-03 pin-ambiguity goodwill applies because the driver's stationary fixes were inside the arrival radius, not at a wrong entrance.

THE DRIVER'S PROFILE POINT. The counterparty statement inviting a look at the rider's history cannot be used: rider_profile.prior_no_show_flags (6) is a lifetime counter that POL-GEN-01 marks CONTEXT ONLY and forbids as a ground of decision. The citable counter, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d, is 1, below the POL-NS-09(d) threshold of 3, so the history neither supports an adverse finding against the rider nor triggers escalation. Escalation is in any case unavailable: no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence (they agree), and no artifact carrying the deciding fact is impaired under POL-NS-08(a)-(d) (no clock skew, no trace gap, chat count matches chat_message_count 1, and the 4.50 fare line reconciles with the platform_policy net figure of 4.50).

CONFIDENCE AND REFERRALS. The deciding fact — the 79-second dwell against the 180-second period — is carried by two independent weight-1.0 artifacts, EV-GPS-02730 and EV-TRIP-02730, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and I set confidence at 0.95. No clause produces a referral: POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire (qualifying in-geofence fixes exist and the marker was true), and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming escalation does not fire.

The refund of SGD 4.50 is within the SGD 8.00 automatic execution threshold (POL-GEN-05) and will execute on issue, subject to the appeal route under POL-GEN-04.

The anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d is 1 and completed_trips_30d is 65, far below the 4-and-0.08 test), and no POL-NS-03 pin-ambiguity goodwill applies because the driver's stationary fixes were inside the arrival radius, not at a wrong entrance.

The counterparty statement inviting a look at the rider's history cannot be used: rider_profile.prior_no_show_flags (6) is a lifetime counter that POL-GEN-01 marks CONTEXT ONLY and forbids as a ground of decision. The citable counter, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d, is 1, below the POL-NS-09(d) threshold of 3, so the history neither supports an adverse finding against the rider nor triggers escalation. Escalation is in any case unavailable: no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence (they agree), and no artifact carrying the deciding fact is impaired under POL-NS-08(a)-(d) (no clock skew, no trace gap, chat count matches chat_message_count 1, and the 4.50 fare line reconciles with the platform_policy net figure of 4.50).

The deciding fact — the 79-second dwell against the 180-second period — is carried by two independent weight-1.0 artifacts, EV-GPS-02730 and EV-TRIP-02730, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and I set confidence at 0.95. No clause produces a referral: POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire (qualifying in-geofence fixes exist and the marker was true), and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming escalation does not fire.

The refund of SGD 4.50 is within the SGD 8.00 automatic execution threshold (POL-GEN-05) and will execute on issue, subject to the appeal route under POL-GEN-04."

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: the cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 is refunded to the rider in full.

What the record shows. The driver reached the pickup pin at Blk 640 Jurong West St 61 at 06:28:20, held position inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for a single continuous run of 79 seconds (9 qualifying fixes, 06:28:20 to 06:29:39, closest approach 0.16 m), and terminated the trip at 06:29:42 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. The free waiting period in force for this trip is 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec). The measured in-geofence dwell of 79 seconds is 101 seconds short of the 180 seconds the fee was meant to buy, and the termination at 06:29:42 preceded the moment the required dwell would have elapsed (06:31:20, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 06:28:20).

Why the fee is refunded. Under POL-NS-06 a dwell shorter than the free waiting period in force makes the cancellation fee non-chargeable and refundable in full, whether or not the rider was present. That is this case. POL-NS-01 is conjunctive and both limb (c) (dwell) and limb (d) (termination at or after the required dwell) fail on the driver's own evidence (EV-TRIP-02730, EV-GPS-02730), so the fee is not chargeable under POL-NS-01 and POL-NS-07 driver compensation is unavailable, being conditioned on POL-NS-01 being satisfied in full. No accumulation of separate in-geofence intervals is possible under POL-NS-06(i): the only advisory in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-02730-01, is MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0) and can carry no fact, and independently the trace shows a single in-geofence interval (run_count 1).

The rider-exonerating route. The rider's own track places her device within 23.2 m of the pin across all 30 qualifying rider fixes, inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius, and her message 'coming out now' at 06:29:20 (read 06:29:40) drew no reply and no in-app call before the driver terminated 22 seconds later. I treat that as a coordinating message, so POL-NS-04 also exonerates the rider. The driver advocate read limb (a) narrowly; the point is immaterial, because POL-NS-06 refunds the fee in full on either view, and neither route carries driver compensation.

The driver's marker and payout. The arrival marker is genuine, not false: at 06:28:20 the driver was inside the geofence at 0.0 km/h, so POL-NS-05's false-arrival limb is not engaged and no POL-NS-05(ii) referral arises. The anti-farming test under POL-NS-07 (no_show_terminations_30d 1, completed_trips_30d 65, against the 4-or-more AND above-0.08 test) does not trip, so his payout is not withheld and the case does not escalate under POL-NS-09(d). I accept the driver's submission that he performed his part in good faith; that does not change the arithmetic above.

The driver's statement about the rider's history. I accept both advocates' treatment of the counterparty statement: rider_profile.prior_no_show_flags is a lifetime counter that POL-GEN-01 marks context only and forbids as a ground of decision, and the citable counter, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d, is 1, below POL-NS-09(d)'s threshold of 3. The statement grounds no adverse finding and no escalation. The referee's flag on that context-only field is noted; the claim was correctly framed as one arguing the field cannot be used, and it is not discarded.

Amount and mechanics. The refund is the whole contested sum, SGD 4.50, being the fare_breakdown cancellation_fee line of 4.50 with total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00 (EV-FARE-02730). No booking or platform fee is involved on a trip that never started. Driver compensation is nil. The monetary effect (SGD 4.50) does not exceed the SGD 8.00 automatic execution threshold in POL-GEN-05. Confidence rests on the dwell shortfall, carried by the GPS trace and the trip record, both at weight 1.0.

The effective in-geofence dwell is shorter than the period the cancellation fee was meant to buy, so under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full.

The trip record agrees with the trace: the driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 06:28:20 and the free waiting period of 180 seconds started at 06:28:22, but he cancelled the trip at 06:29:42 — 82 seconds after arrival. On the platform's own telemetry the waiting period in force under POL-NS-01(c) had not been served when he terminated.

POL-NS-01 is conjunctive and limb (d) fails independently of the dwell point: the trip was terminated at 06:29:42, before the required 180-second dwell — measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 06:28:20 — would have elapsed at 06:31:20. The cancellation therefore did not fall 'at or after the moment the required dwell elapsed', and limb (d) is not met.

Nothing can rescue the shortfall by accumulation. The only advisory in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-02730-01, is MISSING — no advisory covers this pickup in this window — and carries weight 0.0 with the MISSING_ARTIFACT issue code, so it can carry no fact and cannot support summing intervals under POL-NS-06(i); independently, the trace shows a single in-geofence interval (run_count 1), so there is no second interval for that limb to add.

The rider was trying to coordinate and the driver went silent. The rider's message 'coming out now' — a coordinating statement that the rider was on their way out — was sent at 06:29:20 and delivered at 06:29:21; the chat log holds exactly one message, from the rider, the driver posted no reply at all, and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so the driver neither answered within 120 seconds nor called before terminating the trip 22 seconds after the message. Limbs (a) and (b) of POL-NS-04 hold.

Limb (c) of POL-NS-04 is affirmatively satisfied, not undecidable: the rider's device was at the pin throughout, with all 30 qualifying rider fixes inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius and a maximum distance of 23.2 m from the pickup. With all three limbs of POL-NS-04 met, the rider is exonerated and the cancellation fee is refunded in full with no driver compensation payable.

No driver compensation can attach to this trip. POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and limb (c) is not satisfied; POL-NS-04 in any event carries no driver compensation. The driver's 82-second wait is a cost he may raise with the platform, but it is not a charge the rider funds on these facts.

The driver's own GPS trace puts him inside the STANDARD arrival radius of 50 m at the exact moment he tapped 'I'm Here': the qualifying in-geofence run starts at 2026-09-10T06:28:20, the same timestamp as the trip_record driver_arrived event, and his closest approach to the pickup pin is 0.157 m across 9 qualifying fixes inside the radius. POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (b) are therefore satisfied on the driver's own evidence, and there is no false-arrival case for the driver to answer under POL-NS-05.

The trip_record terminates the trip under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is one of the three codes POL-NS-01(d) recognises, with no boarding event and started_at null. The reason-code defect limb (d) polices - a DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE admission that the driver could not find the rider - is not in this record, so the driver terminated honestly rather than mislabelling a rider cancellation as a no-show.

The only chat message on the trip is the rider's 'coming out now' at 2026-09-10T06:29:20. It states no position, names no entrance, block, tower or bay, does not ask for the driver's position and does not say she cannot see the vehicle; it is not the locating or coordinating message POL-NS-04(a) requires, so the rider-exonerating route under POL-NS-04 is not opened on this chat_log, and the driver's cancellation 22 seconds later was not a refusal to answer a request he had been given.

The driver did not circle or leave and return: the trace shows a single continuous in-geofence run with the vehicle at 0.0 km/h at the marker, and the track only departs the pin after the 06:29:42 termination. Nothing in POL-NS-05's false-arrival branch or the POL-NS-07 anti-farming branch is engaged - driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 and driver_profile.completed_trips_30d is 65, against a test requiring 4 or more terminations AND a rate above 0.08 - so no false-arrival referral and no withheld-payout finding belong in this ruling.

The driver's own on-file statement invites the Judge to the rider's no-show record, and I confine that invitation to what POL-GEN-01 permits: the only citable counter is rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d, which is 1 and so falls below POL-NS-09(d)'s threshold of 3, and the lifetime flag counter is CONTEXT ONLY and may not be substituted for it. The statement grounds neither an escalation under POL-NS-09 nor any adverse finding against the rider, and the driver's case does not rest on it.

The dwell arithmetic is not in dispute and I do not stretch it: the qualifying in-geofence run is 79 seconds (2026-09-10T06:28:20 to 06:29:39) against the 180-second free waiting period in force in trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, a shortfall of 101 seconds, and the 06:29:42 cancellation precedes the moment the required dwell elapsed. On that arithmetic POL-NS-01 limb (c) fails and POL-NS-06 returns the cancellation fee to the rider in full, and POL-NS-07 compensation is unavailable because it is conditioned on POL-NS-01 being satisfied in full. What the same record does establish - and what the ruling should carry - is that the driver's own part was performed in good faith: he reached the pin, held position inside the arrival radius, and terminated under one of the three recognised codes, so this is a POL-NS-06 shortfall and nothing more, with no driver-side referral.
